tips.text: Buy extra Blade relics from Varzia; every one carries the Blade as the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Prime Resurgence tab in the Market to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Bank Aya ahead of time; relics and Aya you hold never expire when her stock rotates.
Refine the Blade relics to Radiant and leave the Blueprint relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Join a Radiant radshare squad for the Rare Blades.
Pick the same reward as a teammate at the reward screen; they get bonus Void Traces.
